note: YC hint confirmed: the YC directory company 'Mastra' (batch W25 / Winter 2025, status Active) lists website https://mastra.ai, matching the card's domain exactly — same company. Founder/CEO Sam Bhagwat was previously cofounder of Gatsby.js (open-source React framework, scaled to $5M ARR, sold to Netlify); YC founder bio lists him as sole primary founder contact found. Mastra is an open-source (Elastic-license-style OSS core) TypeScript AI agent framework with a hosted 'Mastra Platform' (Starter/Teams/Enterprise pricing). No funding round amount, investor names, valuation, or revenue/ARR figure for Mastra itself could be confirmed or even found as a third-party estimate within the research window; this should be treated as a real data gap, not an assumption of bootstrapped status, given YC participation typically implies at least some outside capital.
